{{Quote|Weizel has a certain flair for handing problem worlds. Like the Dakshee affair. Who would have guessed the union heads were JAN ringleaders? But Weizel sniffed them out, and resolved the issue without bloodshed.|[[Amier Candle]], as reported by [[Coruscant Daily Newsfeed/Legends|Coruscant Daily Newsfeed]]|<ref name="GNN7" />}}
The '''Dakshee affair''' was an incident that occurred during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dakshee]].

==The affair==
At some point between [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]]<ref name="GNN8" /> and [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="GNN7" /> [[Gerald Weizel]], the [[Governor/Legends|governor]] of [[Dakshee]], discovered that several [[Union (workers)|union]] heads on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] were ringleaders of the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] group [[Justice Action Network]]. Weizel resolved the affair without [[Blood/Legends|bloodshed]].<ref name="GNN7" />

Governor Weizel's involvement in the Dakshee affair, and also in the [[Brella Temior crisis]], gave him a reputation of having a certain flair for handing problem worlds. This reputation eventually led him to be appointed as the new governor of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] in 1 ABY.<ref name="GNN7" />
